top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the prediction of the Z2 quantum spin Hall phase by Kane and Mele together with its first experimental observation by Molenkamp in HgTe. It rests on a simple, general mechanism (spin-orbit coupling with time-reversal symmetry intact giving protected helical edge states), a quantitative experiment, about two decades of independent confirmation, and a three-person allocation that all supporters name identically. The citation can be kept narrow, so it does not overreach to 3D topological insulators and stays distinct from 2016. P002 is a strong, widely confirmed discovery but the pairing mechanism is open and the credit and timing are less settled. P003 is mature precision metrology with a clean two-person allocation, and I prefer any of the three awards to no award.
